description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:237: cycle detection compares SubjectPublicKeyInfo values rather than subject DNs. This is correct: in cross-certified or bridge CA topologies, two certs with the same subject DN but different keys represent different signing authorities and are valid distinct nodes in the path graph. DN-based cycle detection would prune valid paths through bridge CAs. A contributor might suggest using subject DN (simpler, no full SPKI comparison) — that would be wrong and must be resisted.
title: SPKI-based cycle detection in path builder is correct; DN-based would be wrong
